analysis: Renal filtration of H2O occurs in the glomerular capillaries due to their high hydrostatic pressure, which drives the movement of water and solutes into the renal tubules. Reabsorption of water in the peritubular capillaries is facilitated by various mechanisms including osmotic pressure and active transport processes.
